description: February 5th 2016 will see UK-based production duo Letherette release their first new music since 2013's self-titled debut album on Ninja Tune - a record that cemented their place at the forefront of the UK's perpetually shifting electronic underground. Returning from an extended studio interlude, the Refresh EP wastes no time getting down to business, collating four powerhouse trax aimed squarely at the dancefloor and blessed with the signature warmth, soulful character and loping swing that lie at the heart of Letherette's appeal. Simultaneously recalling the certified classic output of early 90s NY imprint Henry Street (Kenny "Dope" Gonzalez, Armand Van Helden, DJ Sneak) and the instantly addictive grooves of Pepe Bradock, Motor City Drum Ensemble and Joey Beltram, Refresh is a startling comeback and signal of intent for 2016.
